# HawkAI
**Confidential · one-page venture proposal**

HawkAI is the live footprint desk for a word or phrase a marketing team already owns — and the campaign move that follows.

Repo: git@github.com:snagaram3/grokhackx.git · `feat/expand-inspect` @ `861ed88`

## The problem

A marketing team can launch a campaign name and still not see where it lives on the internet. Social dashboards count whatever is trending. They do not answer: where did *our* phrase print, on which platforms, with what tone, and what to ship before the peak. By the time a CMO googles the tag, the footprint has already moved.

## The solution

HawkAI is a phrase footprint desk. Look up a campaign name, hashtag, product, or event — Camry, #HeatWaveFit, Just Do It — and the same modules fill from live evidence across X, Reddit, HN, and public APIs: a mind map (hub is the phrase; amber dashes are shared artifacts only), related prints, title sentiment, an occurrence timeseries, five age lenses, and a campaign move with risk. Never an invented WHY. Booster turns a lookup into a war-room.

We do not sell another trending-word finder. We sell the footprint of a phrase a team already owns: where it printed, when, who it lands on, and the campaign move that does not clone the meme. That loop is encoded in the Booster Agent and the live desk, not a slide.

## Why now

Attention fragments across platforms faster than any human war-room can staff. QR and short-link campaigns hide in the graph. Models can cluster; they still hallucinate a cause. We refuse that. Evidence-only correlation — hashtags, QRs, phrases, URLs, cashtags, with receipts — is the wedge, and it is already running.

## What's live

- **Live phrase footprint** — GET /api/trends?topic= looks up a word or phrase across X, Reddit, HN, and public APIs
- **Campaign / phrase lookup** — A marketing team looks up a campaign name; the same desk fills with its internet footprint
- **Natural-language Ask** — POST /api/ask answers live questions and zooms the matching topics
- **Booster intelligence API** — GET /api/booster returns artifacts, footprint correlation, age lenses, campaign moves
- **Phrase footprint desk** — Look up a phrase; related prints, causation bars, and occurrence area chart fill from receipts
- **Correlation mind map** — Radial map of a looked-up phrase: related prints, captured artifacts, first print; amber dashes only for shared receipts
- **Mind-map brain** — Hub is the looked-up phrase. Builds evidence-only correlation graphs — never invents a bridge between names

## Agents

- **Booster Agent** — Capture artifacts, correlate why, five age lenses, competitor campaign moves.
- **PR Review Bot** — AI code review with 0-10 scoring and JSON/Markdown reports.
- **Bug Bot** — Security and logic scan used as a merge gate.
- **Docker CI Agent** — Production image build, smoke test, and Bug Bot on every PR and every merge to main.
- **SmartSalesGuy** — Checks out this repo and writes the VC one-pager from evidence only.

## What's next

- **Public-API ingest is offline** — News, weather, crypto, and sports receipts come from the public-apis catalog. Without them WHY stays social-only.
- **Ingest TikTok / Reels / Shorts caption text** — Almost no hashtags in HN/Reddit titles. Short-form campaigns are invisible.
- **QR image decode, not just QR-shaped URLs** — Campaigns hide the payload in images. Text regex cannot see a poster QR.
- **Shared-artifact bridges on the mind map** — The mind map only draws amber dashes when the same hashtag, QR, URL, or ticker prints on two names. Zero bridges means correlation is still a star, not a graph.
- **News + disaster markers on the same timeseries** — GDELT and NWS land as receipts, but they are not lagged as event ticks against social velocity.
- **Persist tape-watch beyond this browser** — Spike watch lives in localStorage. A CMO on another machine, or a Vercel cold start, sees no last look.

The backlog is not a brainstorm. Booster re-ranks it from real capture gaps after every run.
